hcontainer.name: regulation
hcontainer.heading: Provisions of the 2025 Act coming into force on 5th February 2026

intro.p:
The following provisions of the 2025 Act, so far as not already in force
See section 142(2)(h) of the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025. In addition, sections 72 and 110 of, and Schedule 11 to, that Act were partially commenced on 20th August 2025 by S.I. 2025/904., come into force on 5th February 2026—
